decks.notes: The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing powerful threats early on and locking them out of playing spells with cards like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon. The deck aims to quickly ramp into big creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers to quickly close out the game. Its aggressive playstyle is complemented by cards like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing to deal with the opponent's threats and ensure victory. With a focus on speed and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

Utilize various ways to quickly fill up the graveyard, such as Entomb and Grief, in order to bring back powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using Reanimate and Animate Dead. Use counter spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's game plan. Gain card advantage and selection with Brainstorm and Ponder, while also utilizing disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Brazen Borrower to control the board. Use mana denial with Wasteland to slow down your opponent and secure victory with powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the game and pressure the opponent. Utilizing powerful cards like Reanimate and Force of Will, along with efficient creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Stifle and Abrupt Decay. The versatile nature of the deck allows it to adapt to various strategies and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures, such as Troll of Khazad-dûm and Archon of Cruelty. The key strategy involves using cards like Entomb and Animate Dead to set up the graveyard, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early threats while maintaining control of the battlefield, ultimately leading to a swift victory through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells and removal while utilizing card draw and filtering effects to maintain card advantage. It also includes a companion card to provide additional value throughout the game. The deck includes a variety of lands to support the color requirements of the spells in the deck, as well as a mix of powerful creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan and establish control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into play by using a combination of cards like Entomb, Animate Dead, and Reanimate. These creatures, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty, are able to provide immediate impact on the game and put pressure on the opponent. The deck is also built to protect these combo pieces with cards like Force of Will and Daze, while also having disruptive elements like Grief and Brazen Borrower to control the opponent's board state. Overall, the goal is to outpace and overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures.
